items.text: Jacksonville (Wed/Thu): DNP both days - C Robert Hainsey (knee), RB Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot, limited Wed to DNP Thu). LIMITED - WR Jakobi Meyers (ankle), DE Travon Walker (rib), DE Danny Striggow (concussion), RB Chris Rodriguez Jr., S Antonio Johnson, OL Jonah Monheim. IR - OT Anton Harrison, S Eric Murray, DT DaVon Hamilton. Trevor Lawrence starts.

NY Giants (Wed/Thu): CB Nic Jones (knee) DNP both days. LB Malik Harrison and S Jason Pinnock upgraded to full; RB Cam Skattebo, CB Deonte Banks full. IR - LB Brian Burns, LB Tremaine Edmunds, RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. Jaxson Dart out for the season; J.J. McCarthy starts (matches schedule).
